---
title: "Maintenance of Certification"
---

Members maintain their certified status through annual payment of membership dues and certification fees to the ASA. (See @sec-membership for issues related to lapse of ASA membership. See @sec-usage-of-designation for issues related to effects of lapses on usage of the DSP or AdvDSP designations.)

## Fee Lapses

| Lapse Duration | Consequence |
|---|---|
| Less than 6 months | May be automatically reinstated through payment of lapsed fees |
| 6 months or more | **Permanent lapse**—individual must reapply for certification |

Failure to pay certification fees are grounds for loss of certified status. Exceptions may be granted by the executive director under special circumstances (for example, a prolonged illness).

Certified members may choose to terminate certification at any time, though membership dues and certification fees are nonrefundable.
